create_network_plot: create a NetworkPlot object to visualize the Alpha-Rank interaction network from payoff tables and fixation probabilities
run_network_plot: run compute_and_draw_network on a NetworkPlot instance to render the interaction graph with nodes and edges
plot_pi_vs_alpha: plot stationary distributions against selection intensities with strategy clustering and pie chart annotations
generate_sorted_masses_strats: generate a sorted list of (mass, strats) tuples for ranking strategies across alpha values
draw_pie_chart: draw a pie chart slice on a matplotlib axis to indicate clusters of strategies with identical rank
